title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Sonic the Hedgehog?
description: The Beetle's designer, the Mercedes racing team, two racing legends, a seven-time champion, a talk-show host and Jim Carrey connect Adolf Hitler to Sonic the Hedgehog.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Sonic the Hedgehog?
fun_fact: Alfred Neubauer, who appears with Porsche in 1924, is credited with inventing the pit board: he was the first team boss to signal his drivers with flags and boards from the pit wall.
research_note: The chain follows motor racing from the Beetle's designer to Lewis Hamilton; Ben Schwartz never sat in one frame with a racing link, so Sonic comes in through a real 2020 premiere photo of the costumed Sonic with Jim Carrey.

image.file: File:Bundesarchiv Bild 183-H06734, Grundsteinlegung für Werk des KdF-Wagens.jpg

links.line: In 1938, Hitler laid the first stone of the Volkswagen factory, beside the Beetle's designer, Ferdinand Porsche.

image.file: File:Auto-ontwerper Ferdinand Porsche (rechts) en Alfred Neubauer met een racewagen,race-auto op, SFA007000597.jpg

links.line: Back in 1924, Porsche took a race car to Sicily with Alfred Neubauer, the man who invented the pit board.

image.file: File:Training voor Grote Prijs van Nederland op Zandvoort, leider van de Mercedesploe, Bestanddeelnr 907-1856.jpg

links.line: By 1955, Neubauer ran the Mercedes team, and his star driver was five-time world champion Fangio.

image.file: File:Grote Prijs van Nederland Zandvoort. De winnaar J. M. Fangio (links) wordt gefel, Bestanddeelnr 907-1900.jpg

links.line: Two days later, Fangio won that race, and his teammate Stirling Moss came to congratulate him.

image.file: File:Bob Ives, Lewis Hamilton. Joe Ives, Stirling Moss.jpg

links.line: Moss never won a world title, but he lived to meet the man who won seven, Lewis Hamilton.
In 2022, Sir Lewis told Jimmy Kimmel about being knighted.
Kimmel hosted a bearded Jim Carrey.
